upanishads.label: Load the Upanishads
upanishads.title: Upanishads API: Load Books and Verses
upanishads.description: Filter the Mantrilo books API for the Upanishads, follow pagination, and load chapters and verses from your server.

search-mantras.label: Build a searchable shloka library
search-mantras.title: Build a Searchable Mantra & Shloka Library
search-mantras.description: Use the Mantrilo API to list mantras and shlokas, filter by deity, paginate results, and search your loaded catalog.

sacred-audio.label: Play sacred audio
sacred-audio.title: Mantra Audio Playback Integration Guide
sacred-audio.description: Request signed mantra recording URLs from your server and pass them to your app’s player. See expiration, usage, and availability.

book-reader.label: Build a book reader
book-reader.title: Build a Book Reader with Mantrilo
book-reader.description: Build a reader for Sanskrit verse pages and English retellings of the Ramayana and Mahabharata with the Mantrilo Books API.

vedic-birth-chart.label: Add birth charts
vedic-birth-chart.title: Vedic Birth Chart & Kundli API Integration Guide
vedic-birth-chart.description: Build a Kundli with Mantrilo. See a verified synthetic D1 and D9 response, optional Vimshottari Dasha, and birth time and timezone requirements.

daily-panchang.label: Add a daily Panchang
daily-panchang.title: Daily Panchang API Integration Guide
daily-panchang.description: Build a Hindu calendar using the Mantrilo Daily Panchang API. See local date and location inputs, sunrise-based values, and server code.

featured-mantra.label: Feature a daily mantra
featured-mantra.title: Add a Daily Sanskrit Mantra to Your App
featured-mantra.description: Fetch one mantra from the Mantrilo API and display its Sanskrit and transliteration in your app.
